description: This Java source file defines the DevOpsCommandsActor class, an Akka actor responsible for handling development and operations commands within a distributed Eclipse Ditto service environment. It manages pub/sub communication for devops commands, processes specific commands related to logging and configuration retrieval, handles piggybacked commands, and manages responses aggregation through internal child actors.

classes.name: DevOpsCommandsActor
classes.description: Main actor class managing devops commands, pub/sub interactions, and response aggregation within an Akka actor system.

classes.name: PubSubSubscriberActor
classes.description: Child actor subscribing to pub/sub topics for DevOps commands, forwarding received commands to parent.

classes.name: DevOpsCommandViaPubSub
classes.description: Wrapper class for encapsulating DevOps commands received via pub/sub.

classes.name: DevOpsCommandResponseCorrelationActor
classes.description: Child actor that correlates responses for a given DevOps command, aggregates responses, and sends back to original requester.

methods.description: Processes initial DevOpsCommand, publishes to pub/sub, or publishes directly if piggybacking.

methods.name: handleDevOpsCommandViaPubSub
methods.description: Handles commands received via pub/sub, routing to specific handlers.

methods.description: Processes a ChangeLogLevel command to update logging configuration.

methods.description: Retrieves logger configuration based on the command.
